implementation.parser: Bounded ASCII XML through standard-library Expat, DTD/entity declarations rejected; complete input validation before event delivery, no external resource loading
implementation.tags: First registered name/prefix match, case-sensitive or folded; unique positive IDs; self-closing tags return XML_END with attributes; normal END has no attributes
implementation.data: Complete attribute capacities, unused array slots retained; immediate following text in output-sized chunks, textdone and XML_TXCONT; scan-only callers can skip unread text
implementation.variables: Resolve existing user STRUCTURE, convert targeted flat scalar fields atomically and preserve other values; duplicate folded/unknown/nested field targets reject; disjoint and transitive FOR protections

portable_choices.limits: 1 MiB input, 64 nesting levels, 65536 events, 32 attributes, 254-character names/values and 128 registrations; each block/event charges execution budget
portable_choices.status: XML_FUNCTION=1001 delivery, XML_SCANLIM=1002 continuation, 0 EOF for SCAN/success otherwise; 1 state, 2 invalid, 3 capacity, 4 parse, 5 limit; XML_ERROR=-1 parse identifier
portable_choices.functions: XML_START=100, XML_END=101, XML_STEND=102 retained but not emitted, XML_TXCONT=103
portable_choices.lifetime: CLOSE/reopen resets parser and registration; pause retains state; no ordinary READ/seek on XML FILE; changed backend bytes reject; JSON omits handles/scanners
